info.title: LaunchPad
info.description:
The JSON API of LaunchPad, the dashboard app for Nextcloud: dashboards and their widgets and tiles, kiosk screens, public shares, role-based layouts and permissions, templates and the admin settings behind them.

Every path is served under `/api/v1/`, the version this document describes. The unversioned `/api/` paths keep working, are deprecated, and name their `/api/v1/` successor in a `Link` header next to a `Deprecation` header. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`), and every response carries an `API-Version` header. Paths that implement an external standard keep the formats of that standard and are not described here.

servers.description: The LaunchPad API, version 1, on a Nextcloud instance.

host.description: The host name of the Nextcloud instance.

basic_auth.description: A Nextcloud user name with an app password.

API-Version.description: The version of the API that answered, which is the installed app version.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details document. The members the error already had are kept next to these.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type.

detail.description: An explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies this occurrence.

CalculatedField.description: A calculated field of a widget placement: a formula over the widget's data, other calculated fields and other widgets on the dashboard, stored as its source text and its compiled AST.

name.description: The identifier other fields reference it by; unique on the widget.

expression.description: The formula as written, e.g. `(revenue - refunds) / revenue * 100`.

compiledExpression.description: The AST the editor's parser produced: nodes `literal`, `fieldRef` (`source` is `self` or `widget:<id>`), `calculatedRef`, `binary`, `unary`, `if` and `call`. The server checks it rather than re-parsing the text.

returnType.description: Set by the server's type check on save.

evaluationMode.description: `client` evaluates in the browser; `server` and `both` also materialise the value on the widget's OpenRegister source schema.

serverComputedFieldId.description: The key of the calculated property on the source schema (`launchpad_<placement>__<name>`), null when the field is not materialised.

formatOptions.description: Display formatting (number, date or duration), applied when the value is rendered only.

CalculatedFieldError.description: Why a placement's calculated fields were refused; nothing is saved.

field.description: The field the error is about.

cycle.description: For `cycleDetected`: the cycle as `<widget>.<field>`, first node repeated at the end.

widgets.description: For `cycleDetected`: the widgets in the cycle.

CalculatedFieldWarning.description: A save that went through with a change: a server-mode field stored as a client field (`downgraded_evaluation_mode`: it reads another register or schema, OpenRegister cannot evaluate it alike, or the source schema could not be updated), or calculated properties left on the schema of a removed widget (`server_fields_not_removed`).

DELETE /announcements/{}.description: DELETE /api/announcements/{uuid}: delete an announcement. Its author or an administrator.

DELETE /exports/{}.description: Soft-delete a scheduled export. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

DELETE /tenant-themes/{}.description: DELETE /api/tenant-themes/{id} — delete a tenant theme; one that tokens use only with force.

DELETE /widgets/files/{}/files/{}.description: `DELETE /api/widgets/files/{placementId}/files/{fileId}`. Moves the supplied file into the user's trash bin.

DELETE /widgets/{}.description: Remove a widget placement. Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user. The calculated properties its server-mode fields own on the OpenRegister source schema are removed with it; when OpenRegister refuses, the placement is still removed and `warnings` says so.

GET /activity-report.description: GET a person's activity over a period as counts per activity type and per day (UTC), from the activity events; nothing reports hours. Anybody reads their own. Another person's activity is refused with 403 until an administrator turned activity reporting on with a purpose, is read only by an administrator, carries the purpose, and every such read is written to the audit log.

GET /activity-report/export.description: The same report as CSV, with the same numbers: one row per activity type, one per active day, and the total. The same rules as the report decide who may have it.

GET /admin/activity-reporting.description: Whether activity reporting on named people is on, and the purpose it serves. Administrators only.

GET /admin/catalogue.description: Every catalogue entry, the open requests and the catalogue manager group.

GET /admin/custom-css.description: Read the stored CSS for all of LaunchPad (REQ-THM-003).

GET /admin/public-start.description: Answers `{enabled, token, active, reason, candidates}`: whether the public start page is on, the chosen link, whether it is live, why not (`off`, `no-link`, `not-found`, `revoked`, `password`, `expired`), and the public links without a password that are not revoked or expired.

GET /admin/search-shortcuts.description: List the search shortcuts every search box honours: `{prefix, name, urlTemplate}` per shortcut.

GET /admin/storage-report.description: GET storage use per workspace (a Nextcloud group: the files of its members) and per service (files, trash, versions, each app's app data), now and as a twelve-month series of daily snapshots, the object count per register, and the removable total named apart: trash past its retention and launchpad uploads no row names. Read from the platform's own figures, never by walking files or objects. Administrators only; anybody else gets 403.

GET /admin/storage-report/export.description: GET the storage report as CSV: the total, each workspace and service with its twelve months, and the removable total. Administrators only; anybody else gets 403.

enabled.description: Whether analytics is on for everyone.

optedOut.description: Whether the caller's visits are left out of the counts.

GET /announcements.description: GET /api/announcements: the announcements the user sees now, their drafts when they author, and the categories they follow.

GET /announcements/reach.description: GET /api/announcements/reach: about how many people the target groups reach, for the preview. Announcement editors only.

GET /announcements/{}/comments.description: GET /api/announcements/{uuid}/comments: the comments on an announcement that reaches the user, oldest first.

GET /colleague-activity.description: GET what other people did recently, as the caller may see it: the caller's own activity stream from the activity app, without the caller's own actions, and without events on a dashboard the caller cannot see now. A left-out entry is absent, not redacted, and is not in any count.

GET /dashboards/{}/filter-events/report.description: GET /api/dashboards/{uuid}/filter-events/report — the most-used drill-down paths of a dashboard, counted from its filter telemetry. A path is the sequence of filtered dimensions one user drilled through until a reset; it names dimensions only, never filter values. The dashboard's owner and administrators get every user's paths (scope `all`); another user who may view the dashboard gets only their own (scope `own`); anyone else gets 404.

GET /dashboards/{}/resolved.description: GET /api/dashboards/{uuid}/resolved — resolve the dashboard's content for the viewer's locale. Optional `?lang=<code>` query parameter overrides the user's Nextcloud locale; in strict mode an unknown explicit lang returns 404 instead of falling back. REQ-DASH-039. Response shape: - `dashboard`: the dashboard entity payload - `translation`: the matched translation row - `availableLanguages`: sorted list of codes - `currentLanguage`: the matched code - `isFallback`: true when the primary fallback was used.

GET /embed-settings/telemetry.description: GET /api/embed-settings/telemetry — whether embed usage telemetry is collected.

GET /embed-tokens.description: GET /api/embed-tokens — every embed token's metadata, without JWT or hash.

GET /embed-tokens/{}.description: GET /api/embed-tokens/{id} — one embed token's metadata, without JWT or hash.

GET /embed-tokens/{}/usage.description: GET /api/embed-tokens/{id}/usage — seven days of usage in aggregate, no row per visitor (REQ-EMB-008).

GET /exports/{}.description: Read one scheduled export. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

GET /exports/{}/runs.description: List the runs of a scheduled export, newest first. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

GET /exports/{}/runs/{}.description: Read one run of a scheduled export with every delivery. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

GET /health-ping/{}.description: `GET /api/health-ping/{placementId}`. Returns the health badge for one placement. Returns 401 when anonymous, 403 when the caller may not view the underlying dashboard (REQ-HPING-003 "Caller authorization" — the ping is NEVER performed in that case), 404 when the placement does not exist or has no ping configured, else 200 with the badge (possibly `stale: true`).

GET /livetile/connector/status.description: `GET /api/livetile/connector/status`. Reports whether the OpenConnector `dashboard-http-datasource` capability is currently available, so the config form can hide or disable `connector` source mode (REQ-LIVETILE-005). Requires only an authenticated caller — carries no placement-specific data.

GET /livetile/{}.description: `GET /api/livetile/{placementId}`. Returns the live-tile value for one placement. Returns 401 when anonymous, 403 when the caller may not view the underlying dashboard (REQ-LIVETILE-003 "Caller authorization" — the fetch is NEVER performed in that case), 404 when the placement does not exist, else 200 with the value (possibly `stale: true`).

GET /manifest.description: Build and return the v2 app manifest for the authenticated user. Reads the user's dashboard objects from OpenRegister. Each object with a `slug` and `title` property becomes one page entry and one menu entry. Objects the user owns, plus objects explicitly granted to them via OpenRegister's per-object sharing primitive, are included. Route: GET /apps/launchpad/api/manifest.

GET /office-tiles.description: Handle `GET /api/office-tiles` (REQ-OFT-001): the office tile pack for the signed-in user, a "New ..." tile per file creator the server's office apps register and a tile per enabled office app. Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user with the `office-tiles.list` action.

GET /people.description: GET /api/people. REQ-PPL-003: returns `{users, total, hasMore}`, offset-based pagination, capped at {@see PeopleWidgetService::MAX_LIMIT}. Request parameters: - `filters` JSON-encoded array of FilterObject entries (see REQ-PPL-002 / REQ-PPL-006). - `excludeDisabled` 1/0 boolean (default 1). - `showBirthdays` 1/0 boolean (default 1). - `sortBy` One of `displayName` (default), `group`, `recent-activity` (rejected with 400). - `limit` 1..100 (default 50). - `offset` >= 0 (default 0).

GET /reports.description: GET the shipped reports, each with whether it can run on this instance and the registers or schemas it misses.

GET /reports/{}.description: GET one report run with the declared parameters as query values. An unavailable report answers with the missing names.

GET /tenant-themes.description: GET /api/tenant-themes — every tenant theme, with how many embed tokens use it.

GET /tiles/{}/rdp.description: Returns the `.rdp` connection file of a remote-desktop tile in RDP mode, written from the tile's checked host, port, published program and gateway. The file never contains a user name or password. Returns 403 when the caller may not view the tile's dashboard and 404 when the placement is not a remote-desktop tile in RDP mode.

200.description: The RDP connection file, as an attachment named after the tile.

GET /weather/{}.description: `GET /api/weather/{placementId}`. Returns the weather reading for one placement. Returns 401 when anonymous, 403 when the caller may not view the underlying dashboard (REQ-WEATHER-001 "Caller authorization" — the fetch is NEVER performed in that case), 502 when resolution failed with no cached reading available, else 200 with the reading (possibly `stale: true`).

GET /widgets/files/{}/contents.description: `GET /api/widgets/files/{placementId}/contents`. Returns the configured folder's contents as `{items: [...], nextCursor: ?string}`. Empty folder is HTTP 200 with `items: []`. Missing folder is HTTP 404. Read-denied folder is HTTP 403.

PATCH /exports/{}.description: Update a scheduled export; a changed recurrence is rescheduled. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

icon.description: An icon class or image address.

linkType.description: app (a Nextcloud app id) or url.

linkValue.description: The app id or the web address.

targetGroups.description: Group ids that see the entry; empty means everyone.

POST /admin/catalogue/requests/{}/approv.description: Approve a request with the catalogue entry the administrator completed.

icon.description: An icon class or image address.

linkType.description: app (a Nextcloud app id) or url.

linkValue.description: The app id or the web address.

targetGroups.description: Group ids that see the entry; empty means everyone.

POST /admin/cleanup/purge.description: `POST /api/admin/cleanup/purge` — REQ-CLN-005. Body shape: { "categories": ["expired_locks", ...], // optional, []=all "dryRun": true|false // optional, false default }. Returns the per-category breakdown plus total, duration, and dryRun flag. Unknown categories receive HTTP 400 with the list of valid names so the caller can correct the request.

POST /announcements.description: POST /api/announcements: write a draft. Administrators and announcement editors only.

level.description: info or warning, for a notice.

dismissible.description: Whether a reader may dismiss the notice.

expiresAt.description: When it stops being visible (ISO 8601); required for a notice.

POST /announcements/{}/comments.description: POST /api/announcements/{uuid}/comments: comment on an announcement that reaches the user and allows comments.

POST /announcements/{}/like.description: POST /api/announcements/{uuid}/like: like an announcement that reaches the user; liking twice changes nothing.

content.description: The tile: its title, icon, colours, link type and link value.

POST /dashboard/{}/tiles/import.description: Import chosen browser bookmarks onto a dashboard (launcher-bookmark-import REQ-BMI-001..003): each folder becomes a container of link tiles, each loose bookmark a tile, appended at the bottom. Addresses that are not http or https are skipped and listed back. The widget quota is checked for the whole import; nothing is created when it does not fit. Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user who may add to the dashboard.

201.description: The placements were created; `skipped` lists the bookmarks that were not, with the reason.

POST /dashboards/{}/presence.description: Announce or renew the caller's editing of a dashboard and answer the colleagues editing it, each with display name and start time (building-edit-a-dashboard-together). Needs edit rights on the dashboard and a signed-in Nextcloud user.

POST /embed-tokens.description: POST /api/embed-tokens — issue an embed token; the JWT is in this response only (REQ-EMB-001).

hostOrigins.description: The origins that may frame the embed.

POST /embed-tokens/{}/purge-cache.description: POST /api/embed-tokens/{id}/purge-cache — make every render worker re-read the token now.

POST /embed-tokens/{}/re-issue.description: POST /api/embed-tokens/{id}/re-issue — revoke the token and issue a like one; the new JWT is shown once.

POST /embed-tokens/{}/revoke.description: POST /api/embed-tokens/{id}/revoke — revoke a token; render workers refuse it within 60 seconds (REQ-EMB-009).

POST /embed-tokens/{}/unrevoke.description: POST /api/embed-tokens/{id}/unrevoke — accept a revoked token again.

POST /exports.description: Create a scheduled export. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

parameters.name: recipientId
parameters.description: The recipient whose filter context applies.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: pdf, png, csv or xlsx; the file itself is returned.

POST /exports/{}/run.description: Run a scheduled export now (triggeredBy=manual). An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

POST /exports/{}/runs/{}/retry.description: Retry every delivery of a run that failed for good. An export is reachable by its owner or an administrator (scheduled-exports).

POST /health-ping/validate.description: `POST /api/health-ping/validate`. Validates a candidate health-ping config before the author saves the placement (REQ-HPING-001 "rejected at save time" — host allow-list, fail-closed). Performs NO ping — only the allow-list check that `resolveForPlacement()` would apply.

POST /iframe/framable.description: `POST /api/iframe/framable`. Server-side check of whether a URL may actually be framed (REQ-IFRAME-003 "graceful degradation"). The browser cannot tell an `X-Frame-Options: DENY` / `frame-ancestors 'none'` refusal apart from a normal cross-origin embed, so the widget calls this on mount and shows the fallback card up front when the target refuses framing, instead of a permanently blank frame. Allow-list fail-closed; never leaks the target's response body.

POST /iframe/validate-url.description: `POST /api/iframe/validate-url`. Validates a candidate iframe config before the author saves the placement (REQ-IFRAME-002 "rejected at save time" — host allow-list, fail-closed). Requires only an authenticated caller — the allow-list itself is admin-controlled, not per-user.

POST /livetile/validate-source.description: `POST /api/livetile/validate-source`. Validates a candidate source config before the author saves the placement (REQ-LIVETILE-002 "rejected at save time" — host allow-list, fail-closed). Performs NO fetch — only the allow-list / capability-probe checks that `resolveForPlacement()` would apply.

POST /office-tiles/create.description: Handle `POST /api/office-tiles/create` (REQ-OFT-002): create a file in the signed-in user's own files from an office app's blank template, under a free name (never overwriting). Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user with the `office-tiles.create` action.

POST /role-feature-permissions.description: POST /api/role-feature-permissions. Body: `{name, description?, groupId, allowedWidgets, deniedWidgets?, priorityWeights?}`. Upsert keyed by `groupId`.

POST /status-reports.description: POST a body of work with the rating and summary a person chose, and keep the report in the launchpad register: the figures are computed again and always marked computed, the rating and the summary are marked written when they differ from the computed ones. Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user and OpenRegister (503 without it).

register.description: The register slug of the body of work.

schema.description: The schema slug of its items.

POST /status-reports/draft.description: POST a body of work (the objects of one schema in one register, optionally filtered) and get its status report prefilled, not kept: the figures (total, open, closed, overdue, share closed, days to the deadline), the health rating they give and a summary, each marked computed. The objects are read as the caller.

register.description: The register slug of the body of work.

schema.description: The schema slug of its items.

POST /tenant-themes.description: POST /api/tenant-themes — create a tenant theme; names, values, :root-only CSS and contrast are checked (REQ-EMB-005).

parameters.name: placementId
parameters.description: The widget-placement (tile) ID from the URL (numeric — enforced by the route `requirements`).

POST /widgets/files/{}/upload.description: `POST /api/widgets/files/{placementId}/upload`. Accepts `multipart/form-data` with one or more `files[]` entries and writes them into the placement-configured folder (or a sub-path of it, if `currentPath` is supplied).

PUT /admin/activity-reporting.description: Turn activity reporting on named people on or off. Turning it on needs a purpose, which every report on a named person shows. Administrators only.

icon.description: An icon class or image address.

linkType.description: app (a Nextcloud app id) or url.

linkValue.description: The app id or the web address.

targetGroups.description: Group ids that see the entry; empty means everyone.

PUT /admin/custom-css.description: Clean, scope and store the CSS for all of LaunchPad (REQ-THM-003). Answers with the stored CSS and what the cleaning removed; 400 for a value that is no string or is over 20 KB.

customCss.description: The CSS; an empty string clears it.

PUT /admin/custom-css/dashboards/{}.description: Clean, scope and store the CSS for one dashboard (REQ-THM-003), scoped to that dashboard's region. Answers with the stored CSS and what the cleaning removed; 400 for a value that is no string or is over 20 KB, 404 for an unknown dashboard.

customCss.description: The CSS; an empty string clears it.

PUT /admin/public-start.description: Body `{enabled, token}`. A link with a password, a revoked or expired link, an unknown token, and switching on without a link answer 400.

PUT /admin/search-shortcuts.description: Replace the search shortcuts with the `shortcuts` list from the request body and return the stored list. An invalid list is refused with 400.

PUT /analytics/me.description: Store the caller's own opt-out. A request naming another user is refused.

enabled.description: Whether analytics is on for everyone.

optedOut.description: Whether the caller's visits are left out of the counts.

PUT /announcements/{}.description: PUT /api/announcements/{uuid}: change an announcement. Its author or an administrator.

level.description: info or warning, for a notice.

dismissible.description: Whether a reader may dismiss the notice.

expiresAt.description: When it stops being visible (ISO 8601); required for a notice.

defaultLinkTarget.description: The default way the dashboard's tiles open; anything not a string is ignored.

PUT /embed-settings/telemetry.description: PUT /api/embed-settings/telemetry — turn embed usage telemetry on or off; the change is audited.

PUT /embed-tokens/{}.description: PUT /api/embed-tokens/{id} — update name, description or rate limit; subject, scope and origins never change.

PUT /tenant-themes/{}.description: PUT /api/tenant-themes/{id} — replace a tenant theme; tokens using it follow at once.

PUT /widgets/{}.description: Update a widget placement. Needs a signed-in Nextcloud user. A body with `calculatedFields` is checked first (structure, allowed functions, argument counts, types, cycles across the dashboard) and refused with 400 and a `CalculatedFieldError` when a field fails; the stored fields come back with `returnType` set. Server-mode fields are then written to the widget's OpenRegister source schema as read-only calculated properties.

warnings.description: Present when a calculated field was saved differently from how it was sent.
